label: VP1826 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a VP1826-family locus represented by the DefenseFinder VP1826__VP1826 custom HMM profile and experimentally linked to reduced bacteriophage plaquing when the cloned Vibrio parahaemolyticus RIMD 2210633 vp1826 cassette is expressed from a VSV105 plasmid.
observations: Integron-cassette branch under phage defense system; distinct from the VP_RS08820 locus tag, the individual BAC60089.1 query protein, the individual WP_005464673.1 protein, the source Vp1826 cassette label, the VP1826 HMM profile row, VSV105 plasmid-expression assays, bacteriophage fold-change assay rows, PSI-BLAST homolog rows, the absent VP1826 rule-level DefenseFinder model, unresolved VP1826 component activity and phage readouts, sibling VP1796, VP1817, VP1823, VP1839, VP1840, VP1848, VP1851, and VP1853 systems, and other integron-encoded or phage-defense systems.
